title: Autonomous Coding Agent Landscape — A Range of Autonomy
titleKn: ಸ್ವಾಯತ್ತ ಕೋಡಿಂಗ್ Agent ಚಿತ್ರಣ — ಸ್ವಾಯತ್ತತೆಯ ವ್ಯಾಪ್ತಿ
desc: Coding tools range from autocomplete to agents that plan, edit, run and iterate on whole tasks.
objectives: Place tools on an autonomy spectrum.
Describe how much a human supervises at each level.

title: Autonomous Coding Agent Landscape — Adopting Agents Safely in a Team
titleKn: ಸ್ವಾಯತ್ತ ಕೋಡಿಂಗ್ Agent ಚಿತ್ರಣ — ತಂಡದಲ್ಲಿ Agents ಸುರಕ್ಷಿತ ಅಳವಡಿಕೆ
desc: Roll out agents gradually with permissions, review requirements and a way to measure their effect.
objectives: Start with low-risk tasks and tight permissions.
Require human review of merged changes.
